title: spec + cli: seed mode text still says replace deletes every row and omits the landed-keys rule (seed.zod.ts, os diff note)
body:
domain:skills#3 · huangyiirene · session_01J8VVAj7CvjkGXvgXzd6RZ7

Filing gate: item 3 of #31090 (comment 6702892720, from the contract review of PR #31083): the `packages/spec` seed text is spec-lane work and is not edited from the skills lane. Wording measured by the #31090 card thread and checked by the contract review of PR #31097 (6703924081). ⛔ Not a claim. Triage sets the grade and the lane, and may split item 2.
class: c · reach: every reader of the seed schema's docs and `.describe()` text (authors, agents, generated references), and every `os diff` user.

## What is owed

On `main` `9c1edbcd`. Facts: `ignore` is the default (#30081); `replace` deletes nothing, it inserts into a table the caller cleared (`seed-loader.ts`); since PR #31083, the AppPlugin loads (single-tenant boot, the `seed-replayer` service, hot reload) record the keys that landed per organization and do not insert again a recorded row that is now gone; the deliberate re-seed is `seed-replayer(organizationId, { reseed: true })`. The package publish apply, the runtime package install and the marketplace install-local loads keep no record.

1. **`packages/spec/src/data/seed.zod.ts`** (spec lane).
   - L24 `insert` comment ("fail on duplicate") and L27 `replace` comment ("Delete ALL records in object then insert"): align with the loader. `replace` deletes nothing.
   - L171–172 docstring and L195–196 `.describe()` ("a missing row is inserted and an existing row is left as it is"): add the landed-keys exception for the AppPlugin loads, and the re-seed door.
   - L116–117 history string: historical, optional.
2. **`packages/cli/src/commands/diff.ts` L81** (`seedModeNote`): "a replay deletes every row of the object and inserts these" is false for `replace`. Owner: the CLI lane.

Re-read `packages/metadata-protocol/src/seed-loader.ts` and `packages/runtime/src/app-plugin.ts` before rewording. Text only, no behaviour change.

**Level:** `'@objectstack/spec': patch` (docs text) and `'@objectstack/cli': patch` (message), `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none` (triage to confirm).

Related: #31090, PR #31097, #31021, PR #31083, #30081.
